plugins.name: zcode-mobile-pairing
plugins.description: Pair the ZCode mobile app to this Mac from the desktop UI: /pair-mobile starts a token-protected local server on your desktop workspace and shows a scannable QR; the app can then browse any project and its desktop chats

description_i18n.zh-CN: 从桌面 UI 一键配对 ZCode 手机 App：/pair-mobile 启动本地配对服务器并显示二维码
